title: Hofburg Palace
visualBrief: Individually mapped Hofburg wings around open courts, curved Neue Burg, Michaeler copper domes, Amalien clock turret, library dome, riding school and Stallburg courtyard, Augustinian spire, Albertina terrace and Palmenhaus.

nativeAxes.origin: Exact-Q46242 frame;Y0 reconstructed18.85m Wiener Null Michaeler working datum.

reconstruction.basis: Attributed OSM parts and heights, official heritage wing descriptions and visually inspected exterior photographs.
reconstruction.wingHeights: OSM totals where present; eaves and roof split reconstructed
reconstruction.verticalDatum: Fresh exact-Q46242 relation3898175 and123 component ways agree within0.694mm. Native+X2.678deg points north,+Z92.678deg east; Michaeler dome fixes north-east entry,Amalien clock north-west,Neue Burg curved garden/front wings south-west and Albertina/Soravia terrace south-east. Main envelope includes open courts and is not an occupied replacement mask. Retained public Wien1m DGM Float32 crop in EPSG31256 and10197-value5m native grid establishes relative grade. Heights use published Wiener Null EPSG8881 (156.68m above Adria); modelY0 is reconstructed18.85mWienerNull gate datum. Placement subtracts actual grid height at source anchor,not a nominal0floor. Reconstructed hip slopes/ridges derive from straight skeletons of mapped simplified wing plans; checked numerical roof-plans.json is source input,not surveyed roof planes. Court holes crossing wing boundaries are clipped by polygon difference. Measured acquisition vintage,window counts and architectural floor levels are not asserted.

Seven common plaster,limestone,ceramic tile,copper,timber,granite and painted-metal graphs plus opaque PBR glazing. Carved limestone shares wall graph;small gold pieces share tinted painted metal,slate spire shares tinted ceramic pattern. Those are explicit medium-fi approximations,no embedded/copy textures.

Imperial figurative statues,fountains,heraldic reliefs,equestrian monuments,Palmenhaus centralcrosspavilion,balustrade balusters and fine capitals are simplified/omitted. No fully navigable interiors,underground rooms or neighbouring Michaelerkirche.

Public1mDGM under occupied roofs interpolates and does not survey floor levels. Native5m fixture smooths stairs; source/medium display resamples to4m and clamps only beyond bounded evidence. Physical laptop/phone measurements remain pending.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
